description: Event catalogue for the GDPR Data Subject Access Request journey. Introduces 2 events: EVT-159 through EVT-160. Both events published by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005).

events.name: SarCaseOpened
events.trigger: Customer submits SAR and identity is verified. SarCase created with status = received.

consumers.action: Intra-capability: extract KYC/AML records for the customer and provide to SVC-015 for SAR compilation.
Cross-capability: extract account data, transaction history, and communications data; publish SAR data extract event.
Send SAR acknowledgement to customer with case reference and 30-day deadline.
Write immutable SAR receipt record with received_at timestamp.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar.
events.worm_rationale: SAR receipt timestamp is ICO audit evidence — must be immutable to demonstrate 30-day compliance.

events.name: SarCaseClosed
events.trigger: SAR response pack dispatched to customer within statutory deadline. SarCase status set to closed.

consumers.action: Make secure download link available in customer's online banking portal.
Send response delivery notification to customer with secure download link.
Write immutable SAR closure record including days_to_close for ICO SLA reporting.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-case ordering. SarCaseClosed must follow SarCaseOpened for same sar_case_id.
events.worm_rationale: SAR response dispatch timestamp is ICO audit evidence — immutable proof of compliance with 30-day deadline.
